title: Scaffolded onboarding beacon cards for guided flows
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a set of compact, scaffolded 'beacon' cards that appear inline and in a collapsible side rail to guide users through first-time flows (create API key, run first inference, check cost insights). Cards should nudge the next best action, surface one-tap doc links, and provide lightweight screenshots for each step. Aim for minimal visual noise, high discoverability, and consistent placement across the Console and SDK quickstart panes.
acceptance_criteria: Three card types implemented: inline tooltip (hover/tap), persistent docked beacon, and expandable side rail card
Copy variants reviewed and approved by PM (short, medium, long) and available for A/B testing
Figma comps for desktop and tablet/screenshots in both light and dark themes linked and final
Component accessible via keyboard and screen reader (ARIA labels + reduced motion support)
Telemetry hooks defined for impressions, CTA clicks, snooze, and dismiss events
Engineering PR merges with feature flag toggle; QA sign-off on console-2026.03 release candidate
dependencies: legal-privacy-marketing (copy review for data collection text)
tasks: Design: finalise responsive layout and export assets (Marco)
Design: deliver copy variants and tone guidance (Aisha)

Engineering: implement side rail and persist snooze state (ENG-5984)

notes_accessibility: Tooltips must be reachable via Tab order and announce via aria-live when they appear
All CTAs use descriptive link text (avoid 'Click here')
Provide reduced-motion variant controlled by prefers-reduced-motion
Color contrast >= 4.5:1 for body copy and >= 3:1 for secondary labels
Ensure dismiss and snooze affordances are 44px hit area
localization_notes: Reserve 30% extra width for German/Spanish copy in layout
Use ICU-format placeholders in copy for runtime values (e.g., {api_key})
Provide translator context in the copy doc for 1-line CTAs
Avoid slang or product-specific jargon that doesn't translate (e.g., 'beacon')
metrics: Increase first-run completion rate (create API key + first inference) by +8% in 6 weeks
Target CTR on doc link CTA >= 18% for new users
Reduce time-to-first-inference by 20% for users who interact with beacon cards
Telemetry: record impression, CTA click, snooze, dismiss, and deep-link follow-through
qa_checklist: Verify placement across Console pages (Project Overview, Keys, Quickstart)
Keyboard navigation: focus order and escape to dismiss works
Screen reader: announcement content and role are correct
Feature-flag toggles on/off without layout regressions
Events logged to telemetry with correct event names and payloads
Visual QA: dark theme and high-contrast modes
